name: @openelement/element
//: ADR-0155 (docs/adr/ADR-0155-client-only-entry-subpath.md) governs the "./client-only" export below: it is the full public surface minus the compiled claim executor, pinned to the same publicShapeSha256 as ".", and is deletable as one unit when its written retirement condition is met. Recorded as a JSON annotation key rather than a `//` comment because the package-graph reader (tools/lib/package-graph.ts) fails loud on JSONC.

scripts.browser:test: pnpm run browser:compile && vitest run --root ../.. --project element-browser
scripts.browser:gate: pnpm run browser:install && pnpm run browser:test && pnpm run browser:negative
scripts.browser:gate:full: pnpm run browser:install && OE_BROWSER_MATRIX=full pnpm run browser:test && OE_BROWSER_MATRIX=full pnpm run browser:negative
